transcript.content: Hi, I'm trying to understand Sky Airways' refund policy before making a decision about my upcoming flight. I booked a ticket recently and I'm considering cancelling it, but I want to know what the process would entail and how much I might be out of pocket.
Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

Hi Sky, my name is Emily Wilson, and I'd like to know about your refund policy generally - whether I can get a full or partial refund if I decide to cancel my flight before it departs, and are there any fees involved in doing so?
I can...

I'd appreciate it if you could give me a bit more information about that, Sky. Are there any specific circumstances where we wouldn't be able to provide a refund, and are there any cancellation fees that would apply regardless of how far in advance I decide to cancel?

The refund policy and any applicable fees depend on the type of fare you purchased and how far in advance you cancel. For example, a Saver Economy ticket is generally non-refundable, though taxes and airport charges may be. Flexible Economy, Business, and First Class tickets offer more flexibility, with varying cancellation fees based on the notice period.

If you do not cancel your flight and fail to board, the full ticket price will be forfeited with no refund. Could you please tell me what type of fare you booked so I can give you more precise information?

That sounds like a good starting point, Sky. Unfortunately, I don't have the booking reference number handy, and I'm not sure if that's even necessary to know. Would it be possible for me to get an idea of which type of fare I booked based on my travel dates or something else?

I understand you don't have your booking reference handy. Unfortunately, I cannot determine your fare type based on travel dates alone. To check your specific fare type and the associated refund policy, I would need your booking reference number. This number allows me to access your booking details and provide you with accurate information.

I see, so I won't be able to find out until I have that reference number. Do you think it's possible for you to look up my general fare type despite not having the reference number, or would that require me to provide some other form of identification or proof of booking?

I cannot look up your specific fare type without a booking reference number. The system requires a booking reference to access your booking details, including the fare type. Without it, I am unable to retrieve that information for you.

I understand, Sky. In that case, I think I'll just have to take your word on the general refund policy for now. Can you confirm whether a cancellation fee would typically apply if I cancelled my flight relatively soon after booking, and approximately how long it might take to process the refund once the cancellation is confirmed?

Cancellation fees depend on your fare type. For example, with a flexible economy ticket, there is no cancellation fee if you cancel more than forty-eight hours before departure. However, a saver economy ticket is generally non-refundable. Once a cancellation is confirmed, refunds are typically processed within seven to ten business days to the original payment method.
That's helpful to know, Sky. Seven to ten business days seems like a pretty standard timeline for processing refunds. Perfect, thank you so much

transcript.content: Hi, I'm calling to get some information about my upcoming flight with Sky Airways. I've been considering cancelling it but I want to understand the refund policy first to see if it's worth doing so. Can you tell me a bit more about how refunds work?
Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

Hi Sky, my name is Emily Wilson, and I'm actually planning a trip in about two weeks' time. I was wondering if I could get some information on your refund policy for cancellations before I decide whether to go ahead with my booking or not. Could you tell me a bit about the process?
I can certainly help you with that. To explain our refund policy, I'll need to access the relevant information. Please give me a moment to look up the details for you.

No worries, Sky, please take your time. I just want to make sure I understand how things work before making any decisions. Do you think I'll need to have my booking reference number with me when we talk, or can you still assist me without it?

That's okay, Sky. I don't actually have my booking reference number handy, so if you can still help me understand the policy, that would be great. Can you tell me what kind of refund I'd be eligible for and if there are any fees associated with cancelling?

I'm not finding a lot of information in your description about the refund policy, Sky. Could you please just tell me whether I can get a full or partial refund if I cancel my flight and if there are any specific fees that would be charged to me for doing so?

The refund you receive and any fees charged depend on the type of fare you purchase and how much notice you give before cancelling. For example, Saver Economy tickets are generally non-refundable, though taxes and airport charges may be. Flexible Economy, Business, and First Class fares offer more flexibility, with full or partial refunds possible, often with no cancellation fee if you cancel far enough in advance.

If you cancel a Flexible Economy ticket less than 24 hours before departure, there is a sixty pounds fee. For Business class, a fifty pounds fee applies if you cancel less than 24 hours before departure. First Class tickets are fully refundable at any time before departure.

That sounds like a bit of a process, to be honest. Just to make sure I understand: if I had booked a Flexible Economy ticket and wanted to cancel it within 24 hours of the flight, I'd get a full refund minus a £60 fee, right?
Yes, that is correct. If you cancel a Flexible Economy ticket less than 24 hours before your flight, you would receive a full refund minus a sixty pounds fee.
Perfect, thank you so much
